column3: NASB adds “Jewish” and “native” and renders “distribution” as “serving of food.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “having neglected … to attend” as “to neglect … in order to serve.”
NASB follows the critical text without “Holy”; it adds “But.”
NASB follows the critical text; “pleased before” is rendered “found approval with.”
NASB renders “was increasing” as “kept on spreading.”
NASB follows the critical text without “blasphemous words”; it renders “does not stop speaking” as “incessantly speaks.”
NASB reorders “this Nazarene, Jesus.” A stray quotation mark appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text; “looked intently” is rendered “fixing their gaze.”
